limitations: A grid, not a posterior or a continuous bound; phase and nuisance design fixed at the released model; a synthetic statistic also has a cross term with noise or a real signal
rule: Companion mass from the mass function at each pulsar mass and inclination; Shapiro delay on the real sampling, projected with every search nuisance column and scanned over the full search grid; negligible when the largest statistic for inclinations up to the deciding one is within the limit
